name: Daulet Reyes-Abubakar
location: Geartown — industrial district of chop shops and fabricators, near North Ave and Milwaukee
description:
Daulet Reyes-Abubakar is athletic and fluid, the kind of body that suggests either dancer or fighter — and in Meridian 88, the distinction is academic. At 45, her face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — geneware muscle density treatment — looks natural, hits like chrome — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Her entry into running was involuntary — a debt to the wrong people, a choice between working it off or losing parts — and the debt is still not fully paid. She works as a street samurai out of Geartown, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Daulet Reyes-Abubakar is the kind of runner other runners tell stories about, though the stories vary depending on who she burned last.

core_fears: Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
That they're fundamentally alone and connection is just a vulnerability
Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
core_desires: Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of Meridian 88
A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
coping_mechanisms: Control — micromanages everything within reach to compensate for the chaos everywhere else
Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
blind_spots: Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
psychology.secret: Daulet Reyes-Abubakar has a terminal condition — geneware degradation — with an estimated five years. They haven't changed their lifestyle. They haven't told anyone.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Multilingual fragments — switches languages mid-thought, not for privacy but because some concepts only fit in specific tongues.
speech_patterns.cadence: Flowing and unhurried — talks like someone who has never been interrupted and doesn't expect to be.
verbal_tics: Never uses contractions when lying — 'I did not' instead of 'I didn't'
Calls everyone 'friend' — the warmth varies from genuine to threatening
example_lines: "I don't get paid to have opinions about the target. I get paid to make them stop moving."
"Chrome doesn't make you faster. Training makes you faster. Chrome just means you survive learning."
"You want philosophy, hire a professor. You want someone dead by morning, hire me."

story_hooks: Daulet Reyes-Abubakar's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Daulet Reyes-Abubakar owes a personal debt to
Daulet Reyes-Abubakar intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
narrative_function: As a street samurai, Daulet Reyes-Abubakar embodies the tension between independence and isolation. She is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Geneware muscle density treatment — looks natural, hits like chrome. Subdermal armor plating across torso and forearms — military surplus, scratched serial numbers
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.
affiliation: Semi-independent — has standing arrangements with several crews

decision_rules: Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
habits: Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
Saves a percentage of every payment in physical Quanta, hidden in the walls of their space
breaking_points: Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario
Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized
